Axiom:
When a test fails, the primary diagnostic is `playwright test --trace=on` followed by inspecting the trace via `show-trace`. The trace contains DOM snapshots at each step, network requests, console logs, and a timeline — enough to attribute the failure to a real cause instead of guessing.
«Edit the test until it passes» without trace inspection is forbidden — it routinely mutes real regressions by relaxing the assertion.
